cv.name: Jana Falkenberg
cv.headline: Senior Graphic Designer – Brand Identity, Editorial & Packaging
cv.summary: Graphic designer with eleven years in Frankfurt agencies and in-house brand teams. I build identity systems that hold up across print, packaging and digital, and I enjoy the production side as much as the concept.

experience.title: Senior Graphic Designer

Redesigned packaging range for 46 SKUs; reprint costs cut by 18% through a reduced colour system
Mentor two junior designers and review all artwork before print release

experience.title: Graphic Designer

Art direction of product shoots and coordination with print houses
